name: SolidJS
subtitle: Reactive UI library (signals)
creator: Ryan Carniato
description: A JSX library that looks like React, but components run only once. Signals update exactly the DOM nodes that depend on them, with no virtual DOM and no re-renders, which puts it among the fastest frameworks in benchmarks. Solid popularized the signals pattern that Angular, Vue and Svelte later adopted.

concepts.explanation: createSignal returns a getter and a setter.
createEffect runs when its signals change.
No re-render; only bound nodes update.
The meta-framework for SSR and routing.

codeSamples.label: JSX

pros: Highest satisfaction of any UI framework in State of JS 2025 (89%)
cons: Gotchas such as destructuring props breaking reactivity
